headline: Alibaba plans to build AI into the way merchants run their shops on Taobao and Tmall during 2027, one of its executives has said.
score_reason: Pool score 5 lowered by 1: only the headline could be read, so the executive's identity, the tools and the timetable are unverified.
importance_line: Merchants selling on Taobao and Tmall could see AI built into their daily work from 2027, but the executive, the tools and any timetable beyond the year are not known from the headline.
summary: The South China Morning Post reports that an Alibaba executive said the Chinese e-commerce group will embed AI throughout merchant operations on its Taobao and Tmall shopping platforms in 2027.
notes: South China Morning Post page blocked (HTTP 403). Three Google News searches found no other outlet with this story; a BigGo Finance report on Tmall's Double 11 AI plans is a different story and was not used. Headline only.
